evals.prompt: Prepara el paquete de App Review para una actualización iOS 1.4.2 (108). Solo añadimos un calendario de rachas en Inicio y corregimos un crash al primer arranque. El revisor entra con una cuenta demo y llega a ambas rutas en menos de un minuto. No envíes nada todavía.
evals.expected_output: A preflight package that separates public What's New from private review notes, recommends no video for the deterministic routine update, and stops before any external submission action.
expectations: The result identifies the candidate as iOS 1.4.2 build 108 and does not claim it was submitted.
The result keeps What's New user-facing and App Review Notes reviewer-facing.
The attachment decision is explicitly video omitted because the route is short and reproducible; it does not recommend an optional just-in-case recording.
The result explicitly stops before external submission because the user requested preparation only.

evals.prompt: Apple rechazó nuestra app social por Guideline 1.2. Ya implementamos aceptación de reglas, reporte de un mensaje, bloqueo del autor y desaparición inmediata del contenido. Para demostrarlo hacen falta dos cuentas y mensajes en vivo. Prepara la resubmission y dime si aquí sí necesitamos video; no pulses Submit for Review.
evals.expected_output: A rejection-focused preflight that treats the multi-user UGC safety flow as a justified video case, defines a focused recording and private notes, and preserves the submission authority boundary.
expectations: The result marks the video as necessary and ties the decision to the multi-user non-obvious UGC safety flow.
The recording plan includes rules acceptance, report, block, and immediate content disappearance without exposing credentials or personal data.
UGC compliance details are placed in private App Review Notes rather than public What's New copy.
The result does not claim Apple acceptance and stops before Submit for Review.
